questions.name: Understand the purpose and components of the ITIL service value system
questions.objective: 4.1 Describe the ITIL service value system
questions.text: Which statement best describes the purpose of the ITIL service value system?

answers.text: It describes how all components and activities of the organization work together as a system to enable value creation
It provides a list of mandatory process steps for every incident
It defines the exact technology architecture required for every service provider
It replaces the need for practices, governance, and continual improvement

explanations.a: The service value system shows how organizational components and activities work together to facilitate value creation. This is the correct answer.
explanations.b: Syllabus match 131: regarding ITIL service value system, the service value system is broader than one practice or incident workflow.
explanations.c: Definition clue 131: regarding ITIL service value system, the service value system is not a fixed technology architecture.
explanations.d: Scenario clue 131: regarding ITIL service value system, the service value system includes practices, governance, and continual improvement rather than replacing them.

questions.name: Understand the purpose and components of the ITIL service value system
questions.objective: 4.1 Describe the ITIL service value system
questions.text: Which are components of the ITIL service value system?

answers.text: Organizations and people; information and technology; partners and suppliers; value streams and processes
Guiding principles, governance, service value chain, practices, and continual improvement
Incident, problem, change, service request, and service desk
Utility, warranty, customer, user, and sponsor

explanations.a: Language clue 132: regarding ITIL service value system, these are the four dimensions of service management, not the SVS components.
explanations.b: The service value system includes guiding principles, governance, the service value chain, practices, and continual improvement. This is the correct answer.
explanations.c: Learning outcome clue 132: regarding ITIL service value system, these are practice-related terms, not the full set of SVS components.
explanations.d: Foundation check 132: regarding ITIL service value system, these are key service management concepts and roles, not the SVS components.

questions.name: Understand the purpose and components of the ITIL service value system
questions.objective: 4.1 Describe the ITIL service value system
questions.text: Identify the missing word(s): In the ITIL service value system, the main input is [?]. What is the main input to the ITIL service value system?

answers.text: Suppliers and technology
Outputs and warranty
Opportunity and demand
Practices and processes

explanations.a: Concept contrast 133: regarding ITIL service value system, suppliers and technology may support services, but they are not the main SVS inputs.
explanations.b: Exam wording 133: regarding ITIL service value system, outputs and warranty are service management concepts, but opportunity and demand are SVS inputs.
explanations.c: Opportunity and demand are the main inputs to the service value system. This is the correct answer.
explanations.d: Component clue 133: regarding ITIL service value system, practices and processes help transform inputs, but they are not the main SVS inputs.

questions.name: Understand the purpose and components of the ITIL service value system
questions.objective: 4.1 Describe the ITIL service value system
questions.text: Identify the missing word(s): In the ITIL service value system, the main output is [?]. What is the main output of the ITIL service value system?

answers.text: A service desk ticket
A supplier contract
A process document
Value

explanations.a: Governance clue 134: regarding ITIL service value system, a ticket may be part of service management work, but the SVS output is value.
explanations.b: Practice clue 134: regarding ITIL service value system, supplier contracts can support services, but the main SVS output is value.
explanations.c: Chain clue 134: regarding ITIL service value system, documents may support work, but the service value system is intended to enable value.
explanations.d: The service value system turns opportunity and demand into value. This is the correct answer.

questions.name: Understand the purpose and components of the ITIL service value system
questions.objective: 4.1 Describe the ITIL service value system
questions.text: Which statement about the ITIL service value system component is CORRECT? How do guiding principles support the service value system?

answers.text: They guide decisions and actions across all components and activities of the organization
They replace the need for governance
They apply only to continual improvement activities
They define every workflow step in the service value chain

explanations.a: Guiding principles influence how the organization makes decisions and acts across the SVS. This is the correct answer.
explanations.b: Syllabus match 135: regarding ITIL service value system, guiding principles support decision-making, while governance directs and controls the organization.
explanations.c: Definition clue 135: regarding ITIL service value system, guiding principles apply across the service value system, not only to improvement.
explanations.d: Scenario clue 135: regarding ITIL service value system, workflow steps are not defined by the guiding principles.

questions.name: Understand the purpose and components of the ITIL service value system
questions.objective: 4.1 Describe the ITIL service value system
questions.text: Which statement about the ITIL service value system component is CORRECT? How does governance support the service value system?

answers.text: It removes the need for continual improvement
It directs and controls the organization
It performs every service desk activity
It is the same as a supplier relationship

explanations.a: Language clue 136: regarding ITIL service value system, governance and continual improvement both support the service value system.
explanations.b: Governance directs and controls the organization so it can create value and meet objectives. This is the correct answer.
explanations.c: Learning outcome clue 136: regarding ITIL service value system, governance provides direction and control rather than performing all operational work.
explanations.d: Foundation check 136: regarding ITIL service value system, supplier relationships may be governed, but governance is broader.

questions.name: Understand the purpose and components of the ITIL service value system
questions.objective: 4.1 Describe the ITIL service value system
questions.text: Which statement about the ITIL service value system component is CORRECT? What is the role of the service value chain in the service value system?

answers.text: It defines the four dimensions of service management
It authorizes budget for service consumption
It provides an operating model for the creation, delivery, and continual improvement of services
It describes only the service desk function

explanations.a: Concept contrast 137: regarding ITIL service value system, the four dimensions are separate perspectives that should be considered across the SVS.
explanations.b: Exam wording 137: regarding ITIL service value system, budget authorization is associated with the sponsor role, not the service value chain.
explanations.c: The service value chain is the operating model used to create, deliver, and continually improve services. This is the correct answer.
explanations.d: Component clue 137: regarding ITIL service value system, the service value chain is broader than the service desk.

questions.name: Understand the purpose and components of the ITIL service value system
questions.objective: 4.1 Describe the ITIL service value system
questions.text: Which statement about the ITIL service value system component is CORRECT? How do practices support the service value system?

answers.text: They replace the service value chain activities
They are limited to technical tools and automation
They are the main inputs to the service value system
They provide organizational resources designed for performing work or accomplishing objectives

explanations.a: Governance clue 138: regarding ITIL service value system, practices support service value chain activities; they do not replace them.
explanations.b: Practice clue 138: regarding ITIL service value system, practices include people, processes, information, suppliers, and technology resources.
explanations.c: Chain clue 138: regarding ITIL service value system, opportunity and demand are the main SVS inputs.
explanations.d: Practices are sets of organizational resources designed for performing work or accomplishing objectives. This is the correct answer.

questions.name: Understand the purpose and components of the ITIL service value system
questions.objective: 4.1 Describe the ITIL service value system
questions.text: Which statement about the ITIL service value system component is CORRECT? Why is continual improvement included in the service value system?

answers.text: To ensure the organization and its services keep improving in alignment with changing needs
To focus only on technology upgrades
To prevent any service from changing after release
To replace the need to understand value

explanations.a: Continual improvement supports ongoing improvement of services, practices, and the service value system. This is the correct answer.
explanations.b: Syllabus match 139: regarding ITIL service value system, continual improvement can apply to services, practices, processes, people, and technology.
explanations.c: Definition clue 139: regarding ITIL service value system, continual improvement encourages appropriate change and improvement.
explanations.d: Scenario clue 139: regarding ITIL service value system, improvement should be guided by value and outcomes.

questions.name: Understand the purpose and components of the ITIL service value system
questions.objective: 4.1 Describe the ITIL service value system
questions.text: An organization receives demand for a new service and identifies an opportunity to improve customer experience. Which ITIL concept explains how these inputs are converted into value?

answers.text: The definition of a user
The ITIL service value system
A warranty target
A single supplier contract

explanations.a: Language clue 140: regarding ITIL service value system, a user is a role that uses services, not the system that converts opportunity and demand into value.
explanations.b: The service value system explains how opportunity and demand are transformed into value through its components and activities. This is the correct answer.
explanations.c: Learning outcome clue 140: regarding ITIL service value system, warranty supports fitness for use, but it does not describe the full value-creation system.
explanations.d: Foundation check 140: regarding ITIL service value system, a supplier contract can support a service, but the full value-creation system is the SVS.
